cohort: Neonates admitted to the neonatology unit of the University Teaching Hospital of Kigali (CHUK) whose admission temperatures were recorded between July 2013 and September 2017.
finding: Neonatal hypothermia was prevalent at admission (27%) and significantly associated with higher mortality and increased length of hospital stay, with extremely preterm neonates being more likely to be hypothermic.
gest_age: Varies (includes extremely preterm to term neonates)
